title: Increase Tangential Gain
statement: Increasing the tangential gain will help the robot navigate the tight turns of the chicane obstacles more effectively.
mechanism: The tangential gain affects the robot's ability to maintain a straight path while turning, which is crucial for navigating tight corners.
contradicting_evidence: Experiment plan_blind_1: Observed delta=+0.000. Verdict: inconclusive (). (Did not produce statistically distinguishable change)
